personal.name: Yamen Muammar
personal.title: Software Engineer
personal.bio: A self-driven software engineering student who builds real, production-grade software — learned and shipped from Gaza, against the odds.

about.headline: Resilient, self-taught, and relentlessly building.
about.paragraph1: I'm Yamen — a software engineering student from Gaza, Palestine. I've completed 20+ structured programming courses and independently built real-world applications, including a full government-scale licensing system, this portfolio and SaaS for a Dental Clinic. I care about clean architecture, solid fundamentals, and writing code that holds up.
about.paragraph2: I kept learning and shipping software independently throughout a conflict zone with limited resources. Now I'm looking to grow into a full-stack software engineering role.

projects.title: Dental Clinic System
projects.description: A production-ready clinic management system actively deployed at a real dental clinic. Streamlines patient records, appointment scheduling, and clinical workflows built on a clean, layered architecture.
projects.blurb: A real-world dental clinic management system in active development — handling patients, appointments, treatments and clinical records, built on the same clean 3-Tier architecture as my DVLD system.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A responsive portfolio website showcasing my projects and skills as a software developer.
projects.blurb: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to highlight my work and expertise.

projects.title: DVLD System
projects.description: A comprehensive driving license management system built with C# and WinForms. Handles license issuance, renewals, applicant records, and test scheduling — backed by a relational SQL Server database with full CRUD operations and business logic layers.
projects.blurb: A large-scale desktop app simulating a full government Driving & Vehicle License Department — 15+ screens, 14+ relational tables, 50+ service & data-access classes, 200+ commits.

screens.alt: Replace damaged or lost license form

projects.title: Tech Store
projects.description: Tech Store is a cross-platform (web, mobile, desktop) system centralized by a backend API to manage computer component inventories using SQL Server, implementing CRUD operations for products and orders. Business logic layers ensure inventory integrity, while a secure API connects the front-end interfaces to the database.
projects.blurb: A cross-platform inventory system — web, mobile and desktop front-ends unified behind one backend API over SQL Server, with full CRUD for products and orders.

projects.title: Bank Desktop Application
projects.description: Simple Bank System for Educational Purposes.
projects.blurb: A simple bank system built for educational purposes — accounts, transactions and LINQ-backed queries over SQL Server.

experience.note: 20+ structured courses covering C++, C#, OOP, data structures, algorithms, databases, SQL and Git — from one of the Arab world's largest coding academies (200,000+ students).
In-depth C# course: object-oriented programming, LINQ and .NET fundamentals, with a focus on clean code and real-world debugging.
Began my bachelor's in the Software Engineering program; studies interrupted by the war in Gaza.
Intensive IT & software-development program in Python, covering CS fundamentals; served as a peer teaching assistant.
